### `POST /access/users/{userid}/token/{tokenid}`

```ts
proxmox.access.users.$(userid).token.$(tokenid).$post()
```

Generate a new API token for a specific user. NOTE: returns API token value, which needs to be stored as it cannot be retrieved afterwards!

Returns `object`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `comment` | string |  |  |
| `expire` | number |  | API token expiration date (seconds since epoch). '0' means no expiration date. — min 0, default `"same as user"` |
| `privsep` | boolean |  | Restrict API token privileges with separate ACLs (default), or give full privileges of corresponding user. — default `1` |
| `tokenid` | string | yes | User-specific token identifier. |
| `userid` | string | yes | Full User ID, in the `name@realm` format. — format `pve-userid`, ≤ 64 chars |

### `PUT /access/users/{userid}/token/{tokenid}`

```ts
proxmox.access.users.$(userid).token.$(tokenid).$put()
```

Update API token for a specific user. NOTE: when 'regenerate' is set, the returned token value needs to be stored as it cannot be retrieved afterwards!

Returns `object`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `comment` | string |  |  |
| `delete` | string |  | A list of settings you want to delete. — format `pve-configid-list` |
| `expire` | number |  | API token expiration date (seconds since epoch). '0' means no expiration date. — min 0, default `"same as user"` |
| `privsep` | boolean |  | Restrict API token privileges with separate ACLs (default), or give full privileges of corresponding user. — default `1` |
| `regenerate` | boolean |  | Regenerate the token's secret value. All users of the previous secret will lose access after this operation. — default `0` |
| `tokenid` | string | yes | User-specific token identifier. |
| `userid` | string | yes | Full User ID, in the `name@realm` format. — format `pve-userid`, ≤ 64 chars |
